ColdStartEvidence.description:
Owned-file cache eviction verified before process restart. The measured
interval includes startup and first read; subsequent reads may be warm.

DiagnosticMaintenanceSnapshot.description: Cumulative flush and compaction work since the process opened the store.

max_versions.description: Version count that triggers an automatic flush.

DiagnosticPageCacheSnapshot.description:
The bounded decoded-page cache and the page reads it served or missed.
Hit, miss, eviction, load, byte, and filter counters are cumulative since
the process opened the store.

DiagnosticSegmentIoMode.description: The segment read path rrflowKV requested.

DiagnosticSegmentIoSnapshot.description: Segment file I/O by access path, cumulative since the store opened.

DiagnosticSegmentSetSnapshot.description: The persisted segment set named by the current manifest.

l0_compaction_trigger.description: L0 segment count that triggers compaction.

DiagnosticStorageAdmission.description:
Process-local physical storage observation for the instance's storage
profile. It carries `observation` authority: counters are measured at
`observed_at_unix_ms`, are not bound to the read stamp, and reset when the
process reopens its store.

active_read_views.description: Actual live physical read views and conservative aggregate pin charge.

outstanding_requests.description: Includes the active request plus admitted waiters, matching admission.

retained_mutable_bytes.description: Logical owner charges; these are not allocator or process RSS bytes.

retained_source_bytes.description: Owned source-page allocation charges; excludes borrowed mmap residency.

DiagnosticStorageEvidenceLevel.description: How much physical evidence the instance's storage profile reports.

oneOf.description: The profile has no stable physical counters (volatile rrflowMX).

rrflowKV memtable, WAL, maintenance, segment, page-cache, and segment
I/O counters.

DiagnosticWriteAheadLogSnapshot.description: The rrflowKV write-ahead log tail not yet flushed into segments.

payload_max_bytes.description: Payload size that triggers an automatic flush.

ExpectedOperation.description:
Written by the workload oracle BEFORE execution, not reconstructed from
the engine's response. Digested into the required case in the manifest.

installed_control.description:
The estate's control state outside the catalogues: installed record
and checkpoint, active configuration, security policy and audit chain,
attunement plan and job state, and estate documents. `included` means
the backup carries them as a replayable control-journal archive; the
token key and operator credential are never carried.

verification_finished_ns.description:
End of independent readback while the admitted client slot is still held.
Absent in historical evidence; never infer zero verification cost.

NativeAllocationReceipt.description:
Launcher receipt, retained with samples. Its digest binds declared native
controls; the installed driver separately checks live kernel membership.

oneOf.description:
A positive absence observation after authoritative recovery. Omission
of a readback entry is unresolved, NOT proof of absence.

private_bytes.description:
Linux private resident pages; Windows private committed memory. Native
platforms must be compared separately; neither is process RSS.

retained_bytes.description: Missing logical ownership metrics remain explicit, never zero-filled.

WriteTransition.description:
Bounded load-slot identity, separate from immutable seeded read coordinates.
Generation advances only after acknowledged independent readback.
